description: GX-31 (D-070, GA-P02 strict, P-43): before a tier-2 run (the batch head or a bisection probe) the train looks for a gate.passed at the v4 proof version on the repository channel, read through a forge adapter that keeps only trusted author associations (the port re-validates every event_id), whose input_digest, head tree, base, plan, selection, attested toolchain_id (GX-28) and gate_version equal the ones it recomputes; a match is the verdict and nothing runs, anything else runs. Off is the one-key rollback: tier 2 never reuses (D-065 (5) as before GX-31).
